description: End-to-end task evals for the habitat-usage skill. These evals cover pinned Habitat setup, dependency manifest authoring, and troubleshooting common hab sync failures.

evals.name: pin-wrapper-and-basic-deps
evals.prompt: 我要在一个主仓库里引入 Habitat 管理依赖。请给我最小落地方案：固定 Habitat 版本，提交 wrapper，并写出 `.habitat` 和 `DEPS` 的基本示例，主依赖仓库放到 `third_party/lib`。
evals.expected_output: A setup plan that pins a Habitat release, commits `hab`, `.habitat`, and `DEPS`, and shows a `DEPS` git dependency under `third_party/lib`.
expectations: The answer recommends pinning a concrete Habitat version instead of downloading `releases/latest` for automation.
The answer includes committing the Habitat wrapper plus `.habitat` and `DEPS` to the repository.
The `.habitat` example defines a solution with `deps_file: "DEPS"` and the main repository URL.
The `DEPS` example defines `deps = { ... }` and uses `third_party/lib` as the destination key.
The dependency entry uses `type: "git"` and includes a dependency repository URL.

evals.name: troubleshoot-sync-auth-failure
evals.prompt: `./hab sync .` 在 CI 里拉 git 依赖失败，报 permission denied。请告诉我应该先收集哪些信息，以及最可能的排查步骤。不要让我粘贴密钥。
evals.expected_output: A troubleshooting checklist that collects Habitat version, OS/arch, exact command and error, `.habitat`/`DEPS` snippets, then checks git auth and URL protocol without exposing secrets.
expectations: The response asks for Habitat version or wrapper distribution information.
The response asks for OS/architecture and the exact `./hab sync .` command plus full error output.
The response asks for relevant `.habitat` and `DEPS` snippets while explicitly avoiding secrets.
The response points to git authentication or credential setup as a likely cause.
The response checks whether SSH versus HTTPS URLs match the CI environment.

evals.name: http-asset-integrity
evals.prompt: 我要用 Habitat 下载一个二进制压缩包 `https://example.com/tooling.zip` 到 `tools/tooling`，并且 CI 里要做完整性校验。给我 `DEPS` 片段和同步命令。
evals.expected_output: A `DEPS` snippet using an http dependency with `url` and `sha256`, followed by `./hab sync .`.
expectations: The dependency entry includes the exact URL `https://example.com/tooling.zip`.
The dependency entry includes a `sha256` field for integrity verification.
The answer includes the sync command `./hab sync .`.
